high_level_description: The image depicts a scene inside what appears to be a tailoring or fashion design workshop. The setting is well-lit with white walls adorned with framed images of individuals working on garments. There are mannequins dressed in suits, one prominently featured in the foreground wearing a brown tweed suit jacket. In the foreground, a woman stands next to the mannequin, gesturing towards it while holding a piece of fabric. She is dressed in a black blazer and jeans, and she appears to be explaining something about the construction of the garment.
